name: attend-slack-notifications
description: Cloudflare Worker that posts to Slack whenever someone new signs up for a Hack Club Attend event.

ATTEND_TOKEN.description: An Attend mobile token. In BetterAttend: Settings → Developer → Copy a new mobile token. The worker rotates it automatically.

SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Slack incoming webhook URL to post sign-ups to (https://api.slack.com/messaging/webhooks).

ADMIN_KEY.description: Type `none` to skip, or any long random string to enable the /status, /poll, /test and /reset endpoints.

ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Type `default` to use SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL, or a separate Slack webhook for alerts like an expired token.

ATTEND_EVENT.description: Event slug or ID: the last part of your event's attend.hackclub.com/admin/ URL. Comma-separate several.

MESSAGE_TEMPLATE.description: Type `default`, or your own message using `{name}`, `{mention}`, `{count}` and [more](https://github.com/ingoau/attend-slack-notifications#placeholders).

SUMMARY_TEMPLATE.description: Sent when 6+ people sign up at once. Type `default`, or your own using `{new_count}` and `{count}`.

SLACK_PAYLOAD_TEMPLATE.description: Advanced. Type `none`, or a whole Slack message as JSON. [Example](https://github.com/ingoau/attend-slack-notifications#full-payloads-block-kit)
